dimensions.note: No credentials, network adapter, or secret configuration.
Every method emits structured entry and completion logs without feedback content.
Strict validation, provenance, prompt/hash, grounding, chronology, privacy, and authority checks all occur before writes.
Seven Deno tests cover deterministic replay, redaction, limits, no-authority behavior, malformed and tampered inputs, grounding, chronology, and persistence.
Identical inputs produce identical payloads and stable instance names; repeated writes may add an identical store version and this is documented.
No files, workspaces, network connections, or external handles.
README and tests use synthetic identifiers and example-only content.
All object schemas are strict, IDs and collections are bounded, and schema/write field coverage is exact.
All three resources declare a 30-day lifetime and GC retention of 10.
This is a local bounded transformation pipeline, not an external CRUD lifecycle.
No external mutation or side-effect authority.
Each resource spec has one writer and normalized-, request-, and triage- prefixes prevent cross-spec collisions.
Methods receive and strictly validate explicit prior-stage artifacts; they do not access the repository directly.
Initial unpublished model version; no prior schema exists to migrate.
